display_long_description:
Discover the transformative digital realm of iQSTEL's Metaverse, a creation of our visionary subsidiary, Reality Border.

Enriched with AI-driven NPCs, our platform offers an unmatched virtual experience.

As part of iQSTEL Inc., a multinational leader, we are passionate about fulfilling diverse human needs, from digital communication to metaverse explorations.

Dive into a world where customer relations transform through immersive group interactions, making product discovery and history more engaging. Seize the opportunity to shape your unique metaverse.

Our advanced technology supports vast audiences, from live streaming to multiplayer gaming, setting new benchmarks in the digital world.

Experience our Show Room's exclusive preview, explore the revolutionary TuVolten 550 Elite, and interact with Marc, our informative NPC.

With intuitive audio guides, clearly marked zones, and a user-reporting feature, navigate our metaverse with ease and security.
